// Negative fixture for the DES-13 drift guard. This file is NOT part of the app; it
// lives under tests/fixtures so the guard's app/ walk never sees it. It exists to
// prove that a raw hex introduced inside a .tsx inline <style> block is detected.
export function DriftFixture() {
  return (
    <div className="fixture">
      <style>{`
        .fixture { color: #123456; }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}
